summary: Co-op game entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: It Takes Two
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC build with co-op/Friend's Pass state documented

primary.version: Current PC build with Friend's Pass/co-op state documented
primary.why: It Takes Two is designed exclusively around two-player co-op, and the PC version gives the strongest capture/settings path while preserving local or online split-screen play. The Friend's Pass/access setup and partner state are part of the archive context.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC version. Record storefront/build, Friend's Pass or full-copy setup, local or online co-op, partner/controller setup, graphics settings, and whether Switch or console ports were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting the Switch conversion.
secondary.why: The PC route is stronger for capture, while Switch changes performance/access assumptions.

all_releases.platform: Windows PC / PlayStation 4 / PlayStation 5 / Xbox One / Xbox Series X|S
all_releases.fidelity: Original release family with PC preferred for capture/settings.
Portable console port with local wireless value.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The game requires two-player co-op; partner setup and online/local state are part of the route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record co-op partner, access method, controller setup, and online/local split-screen state.
